killedBy: the reduced-motion fan-out (issue #651) routes the policy to EVERY render system that declares an answer to it
why: The hole issue #651 names: 'no test asserts the fan-out at all. A mutation that drops a module from renderer.ts's list survives today.' It did -- `createRenderer` builds a real WebGLRenderer, which jsdom cannot provide, so nothing could construct one to spy on. Under this the barrel recoil kicks at full strength for a player who asked for reduced motion, and every other reduced treatment still works, so the feature looks wired. Barrel recoil is the one picked because it is unconditional: the three blocked-fire systems are `?dev=1` only and muzzle smoke is null on the `low` preset, so dropping any of those would be a weaker mutation than this.
